sessions.deleteAllConfirmDescription: Every saved session will be permanently removed and replaced with a fresh empty session.

workspace.title: Your next application starts here
workspace.description: Use this clean workspace as the foundation for your own product and replace the starter content as your application grows.
workspace.shellDescription: Rust and GPUI shell with movable sidebars, ready to extend.
workspace.sessionsDescription: Create, select, rename, and delete local workspaces from the sidebar.
workspace.securityDescription: Safe Rust with strict validation, URL allow-lists, and verified updates.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dateFormatDescription: Choose how dates are formatted across the interface.
settings.launchAtStartupDescription: Automatically start BaseApp when you sign in to your computer.
settings.sideBarLocationDescription: Controls whether the primary side bar appears on the left or right. The secondary side bar appears on the opposite side.
settings.statusBarVisibleDescription: Controls the visibility of the status bar at the bottom of the workbench.
settings.pageZoomDescription: Adjust the zoom level of the window. Each increment scales the interface by 20%.
settings.windowOpacityDescription: Make the window semi-transparent to see content behind it.
settings.alwaysOnTopDescription: Keep the application window above other windows.
settings.resetWindowLayoutDescription: Restore default window size, position, and sidebar geometry.
settings.showTrayIconDescription: Show BaseApp in the system tray.
settings.minimizeToTrayOnCloseDescription: Hide the window in the system tray instead of quitting when it is closed.
settings.trayIconDescription: Choose the system tray icon style.
settings.startMinimizedDescription: Start the application hidden in the system tray instead of showing its window.
settings.hiddenFromShellWarning: Both the taskbar entry and system tray icon are hidden. Keep at least one enabled to reach the window easily.
settings.contentProtectionDescription: Hide the window from screen sharing, screenshots and recordings.
settings.telemetryDescription: Send the application version, platform, locale, and an anonymous installation identifier at startup.
settings.backupSettingsDescription: Export your preferences to a JSON file or restore from a backup.
settings.dataFolderDescription: Open the folder where application settings and sessions are stored.
settings.resetSettingsDescription: Restore all preferences back to their factory defaults.
settings.resetSettingsConfirmDescription: Your saved preferences will be replaced with default values. Saved sessions will not be deleted.
settings.hardwareAccelerationDescription: Use GPU acceleration when available. Disable if you experience rendering glitches.
settings.restartRequired: Restart the application for hardware acceleration changes to take effect.
settings.logLevelDescription: Control the verbosity of application logs.
settings.logFilesDescription: Open the folder containing application log files.
settings.clearLogsConfirmDescription: All stored diagnostic log files will be removed.
settings.checkUpdatesOnStartupDescription: Check GitHub Releases when the application starts.
settings.unattendedUpdatesDescription: Download updates in the background, install them silently, and restart without asking.
settings.author: Author
settings.releasesDescription: View version history and release notes on GitHub.
settings.reportIssueDescription: Report bugs or request features on GitHub.
